acceptanceCriteria: With the opt-in flag the project's reporters run and produce their outputs in the same run, and the provider receipt is still retained and accepted by test-validity.
The receipt binds the original reporter list; without the flag behavior and bytes are unchanged.
The PWP spec records the requirement and its limits; a maintained test covers both modes.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#670. Since #665 test-validity abstains with no-retained-evidence unless the run goes through `corvint-js-test-provider e2e --retain`, whose controlled config replaces the project's reporter list. An adopter's own reporter writes evidence manifests its gates need, so they must run the 25-minute suite twice or lose one side's evidence. Coordinator decision: implement the issue's first option, an opt-in flag (e.g. --keep-reporters) that appends the provider reporter to the project's original reporter list and binds the original reporter entries (and config digest, already PWP-V0-002) in the retained receipt. The default stays replace-only; the qualified tuple and sensitive-input policy guarantees must hold, and anything the provider cannot observe about extra reporters is recorded as UNKNOWN rather than trusted. Ingest from foreign JSON/blob reports is out of scope. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360), reporter on main-0b5096c; corvint-tasks build 202.
